<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that claims handlers lack real-time visibility into garage repair progress and must manually call suppliers. I checked the five most similar items: policyholder milestone notifications (Notion), claim information display (Shortcut 4135, in progress), task list improvements (Shortcut 4134, in progress), task overview (Notion), and bulk document upload (Shortcut 4127, completed). None of these address garage/supplier repair status visibility; the completed story (4127) concerns document uploads, and the others cover notifications, claim display, and task management. All similarities are low (≤0.093), and no shipped story or roadmap item covers this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
